README.md:81:## 📋 API Endpoints
README.md:82:
README.md:83:### Core Endpoints
README.md:84:- **Health**: `GET /health`
README.md:85:- **Authentication**: `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/register`
README.md:86:- **Job Search**: `POST /api/search-jobs` (main pipeline)
README.md:87:- **Agents**: `GET/POST/DELETE /api/agents`
README.md:88:- **Leads**: `GET /api/leads`
README.md:89:- **Campaigns**: `GET/POST /api/campaigns`
README.md:90:
README.md:91:### Email Services
README.md:92:- **SES**: `POST /api/ses/send-email`, `POST /api/ses/send-bulk-email`
README.md:93:- **Instantly**: Campaign management via Instantly.ai
README.md:94:- **Smartlead**: AI-powered email campaigns
README.md:95:
README.md:96:## 🔧 Configuration
README.md:97:
README.md:98:Key environment variables needed (see `render-env-vars.template`):
README.md:99:- `OPENAI_API_KEY` - OpenAI for AI features
README.md:100:- `RAPIDAPI_KEY` - RapidAPI for contact finding
README.md:101:- `HUNTER_API_KEY` - Hunter.io for email verification
README.md:102:- `INSTANTLY_API_KEY` - Instantly.ai for campaigns
README.md:103:- `SMARTLEAD_API_KEY` - Smartlead.ai integration
README.md:104:- `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` - Amazon SES
README.md:105:- `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` - Database
README.md:106:
README.md:107:## 🐳 Docker Deployment
README.md:108:
README.md:109:```bash
README.md:110:docker build -t coogi-backend .
README.md:111:docker run -p 8001:8001 coogi-backend
README.md:112:```
README.md:113:
README.md:114:## 📝 Key Features
README.md:115:
README.md:116:- ✅ **Complete Pipeline**: JobSpy → RapidAPI → Hunter.io → Email Services
README.md:117:- ✅ **Multiple Email Providers**: SES, Instantly.ai, Smartlead.ai
README.md:118:- ✅ **Modular Architecture**: Clean separation of concerns
README.md:119:- ✅ **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error handling and logging
README.md:120:- ✅ **Rate Limiting**: API rate limiting and retry logic
README.md:121:- ✅ **Database Integration**: Supabase for persistence and logging
README.md:122:- ✅ **Progressive Agents**: Advanced lead qualification system
README.md:123:
README.md:124:## 🔗 Frontend Integration
README.md:125:
README.md:126:This backend works with the Next.js frontend located in `../frontend/`.
README.md:127:
README.md:128:Backend runs on: `http://localhost:8001`  
README.md:129:Frontend runs on: `http://localhost:3000`

supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:100:-- Create a view for easy querying of the complete flow
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:101:CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW company_processing_flow AS
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:102:SELECT 
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:103:    cps.batch_id,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:104:    cps.company,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:105:    cps.job_title,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:106:    cps.job_url,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:107:    cps.final_recommendation,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:108:    cps.processing_success,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:109:    cps.processing_error,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:110:    dsr.domain,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:111:    dsr.search_success as domain_found,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:112:    lr.linkedin_identifier,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:113:    lr.resolution_success as linkedin_resolved,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:114:    ra.has_ta_team,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:115:    ra.contacts_found,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:116:    ra.company_found as rapidapi_company_found,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:117:    he.emails_found,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:118:    he.search_success as hunter_success,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:119:    ic.campaign_id,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:120:    ic.leads_added,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:121:    ic.campaign_success as instantly_success,
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:122:    cps.timestamp
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:123:FROM company_processing_summary cps
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:124:LEFT JOIN domain_search_results dsr ON cps.batch_id = dsr.batch_id AND cps.company = dsr.company
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:125:LEFT JOIN linkedin_resolution lr ON cps.batch_id = lr.batch_id AND cps.company = lr.company
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:126:LEFT JOIN rapidapi_analysis ra ON cps.batch_id = ra.batch_id AND cps.company = ra.company
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:127:LEFT JOIN hunter_emails he ON cps.batch_id = he.batch_id AND cps.company = he.company
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:128:LEFT JOIN instantly_campaigns ic ON cps.batch_id = ic.batch_id AND cps.company = ic.company
supabase/supabase_company_tracking.sql:129:ORDER BY cps.timestamp DESC;
